newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek short rates up on money squeeze, bonds down.
newsitem.headline: Greek short rates up on money squeeze, bonds down.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were up half a point in short-tenors and 10 to 20 basis points in longer periods on tighter liquidity conditions putting downward pressure on fixed coupon bonds, dealers said.

"Short-term depos and forex forwards are trading half a point higher than late Friday," said a senior dealer at a foreign bank. "These rates are liquidity-driven and have risen due to tighter liquidity conditions."
The dealer said he expected the central bank to intervene and inject short-term funds into the market to relieve the market.
Dealers attributed the liquidity squeeze to outflows of about 350 billion drachmas linked to telecom OTE's recent part-flotation and the auction of 150 billion drachmas of seven-year FRNs on June 26.
"Long rates are also up, 10 to 20 basis points depending on tenors," said a senior dealer at a private bank.
Fixed coupon bonds were facing a bout of selling that drove prices lower about 30 basis points, bond traders said.
"The higher interbank rates have hit the bond market pushing prices down about 30 basis points," said a bond dealer at a private bank. "FRNs hold for the moment."
Ecu/drachma was trading in narrow ranges between 309.0/50 but dealers said it was a matter of time before adverse developments in other markets spill over in the forex market.
"The forex market is calm and ecu/drachma hovers in the 309.20/30 range," said a forex dealer. "The mark is weak against other EMS currencies and this helps the drachma."
A stronger yen could prompt some corporates to get out of yen-denominated loans and weaken the drachma, the dealer said.
About 60 billion yen were bought against drachmas at the fixing last Friday.
The mark was quoted at 157.91/96 from Friday's 158.060 fix, the dollar at 273.08/18 drachmas from 272.940 and the ecu at 309.11/21 from 309.250 drachmas.

** Overnight at 12.10-12.60
** One week at 11.50-12.00
** Two weeks at 11.40-11.90
** Three weeks at 11.40-11.90
** One month at 11.40-11.90
** Two months at 11.40-11.90
** Three months at 11.40-11.90
** Six months at 10.80-11.30
** Nine months at 10.60-11.10
** Twelve months at 10.40-10.90
--Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
